title: Blaise – A modern self-hosting zero-legacy Object Pascal compiler targeting QBE
summary: Blaise is a modern, self-hosting Object Pascal compiler built from scratch targeting QBE (Quick Backend), designed with zero legacy constraints to provide a clean, contemporary implementation of the Pascal language.
problem_solved: Provides a modern Object Pascal compiler without legacy baggage, enabling cleaner language implementation and easier maintenance compared to traditional Pascal compilers.
why_valuable: Its self-hosting nature means the compiler is written in its own language, demonstrating practical use while offering a fresh foundation for Pascal development in modern contexts.
